manager.title: Manage profiles
manager.onlyOne: This is your only profile, so there is nothing here to delete.

nameTooLong.title: That name is too long
nameTooLong.message: A profile name can be at most {max} characters, and that one is {length}. Your account cannot store it, and keeping it here would stop every other change reaching your other devices.

deleteOne.title: Delete this profile?
deleteOne.message: "{name}" holds {contents}. Deleting it removes its workspaces, groups and links from this browser and from your account, on every device. This cannot be undone.

nothingToDelete.title: Nothing to delete
nothingToDelete.message: The profile you are looking at is the only one there is, and it is the one profile this cannot remove.

message.one: This deletes {count} profile and everything in it — workspaces, groups and links — from this browser and from your account, on every device. The profile you are looking at now is kept. This cannot be undone.
message.other: This deletes {count} profiles and everything in them — workspaces, groups and links — from this browser and from your account, on every device. The profile you are looking at now is kept. This cannot be undone.
